name: SPIE Medical Imaging Grand Challenge 2015
description: A community challenge providing standardized medical imaging datasets and evaluation metrics for benchmarking image-analysis algorithms at the SPIE Medical Imaging conference.
evaluation_method: task-dependent medical metrics (Dice/F1 for segmentation; AUC, sensitivity/specificity or accuracy for classification/detection)
reputation: A well-regarded community challenge in the medical imaging community that provides standardized data and attracts research groups, though uptake varies by year and task.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; tasks and metrics vary by year and challenge; dataset sizes and difficulty differ across subchallenges; potential for small or specialized datasets and limited generalizability across imaging modalities.
